publications.intro: I have always been deeply grateful to all those developers who have selflessly made their knowledge available to the community. I owe a significant part of my professional training to many of them. In recent months, I have started sharing my own knowledge, contributing my own small part to this community.

professionalInfo.career:
I have more than 20 years of experience in the software industry and have worked for major companies such as Repsol, Vodafone, Línea Directa, Banco Santander, and HBX Group, among others. In many of these projects, I have been responsible for designing, documenting, and leading the Front End architecture from scratch, which has allowed me to consolidate solid expertise in this field.

 My role has not only involved creating robust architectures, but also providing technical leadership to Front End development teams, establishing best practices to ensure the delivery of scalable, high-quality applications.In addition to leading, I am actively involved in development, which allows me to stay up to date with the latest technological trends and continue adding value as a hands-on developer. This practical and up-to-date approach is key to ensuring the success of the projects I lead. I have strong Back End knowledge and advanced experience in UX/UI, which provides me with a comprehensive view of the technical needs of any application.

 In 2022, I had the opportunity to lead the architecture of Repsol’s ARIA project, which was a key component of the Stock Control application. This project was recognized in 2023 with the Best in Class award at Expoquimia. Thanks to this success, I became a reference within Repsol for Front End architecture.

 In 2024, I was leading the development of the Front End architecture of an application designed to manage the digital signature of all proposals issued by the Congress of Deputies and the main bodies of the Spanish public administration. This project is based on a modular microsites architecture, combined with the creation of a custom component library. This solution not only optimizes development speed and robustness, but also enables greater independence between modules, positioning itself as a key innovation in the future of web development.

 Currently, I am leading the Front End architecture for the integration of Perfect Stay packages into the HotelBeds platform for HBX Group, the world's largest B2B bedbank. I have also led the Front End architecture behind HotelBeds' recent rebranding, through which the company unveiled its new brand identity and designs. It is one of the most technically demanding projects I have worked on, given the scale and complexity of HBX Group's distributed systems.

milestones.name: Repsol: ARIA - Stock Control

milestones.name: Vodafone: IDM

milestones.name: Línea Directa: Roadside Assistance App
milestones.description: Designed and developed the Front End architecture of the first web application for tracking roadside assistance. The project received wide media coverage, featuring Matías Prats in national news.

projects.title: Things I design and build
projects.intro: Free, open learning tools and developer utilities I build outside work. Each one is a real product: designed, built and deployed end to end.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.description: Over 20 years designing, documenting and leading Front End architectures from scratch for Repsol, Vodafone, Banco Santander and HBX Group: modular, scalable systems built so teams can ship fast and with quality.

ux.title: UX / UI
ux.description: Advanced UX/UI experience: I design clear, consistent interfaces backed by design systems and custom component libraries, with accessibility and performance in mind. A complete view that connects what users see with how it is built underneath.

dev.title: Dev
dev.experience: Over 20 years in the software industry and, even while leading architectures, I still code as one more member of the team: clean, tested code built to scale on projects like Repsol ARIA, awarded Best in Class at Expoquimia.
dev.skills: Angular and its ecosystem (NgRx, Signals, RxJS), React and Next.js, TypeScript, Node, micro-frontends, testing and modern CSS. I pick the tool for the problem, not the other way round.
dev.community: I owe a lot to the people who share what they know, so I give something back: kitforweb, CSS Layout Lab, Play RxJS and other free, open guides for junior and senior developers.

ai.title: AI
ai.control: I use AI as one more tool under my control: Claude Code and GitHub Copilot work within my rules, my architecture and my standards. I make the decisions, review every change and own the result.
ai.productivity: AI multiplies my productivity: I delegate repetitive work, explore alternatives in parallel and keep several fronts moving at once without losing quality, so my time goes where it really adds value.
